name: NVIDIA Blackwell datasheet (GB200 NVL72 / GB200 NVL4 / HGX B200)
notes: Byte-identical copy of NVIDIA's Blackwell datasheet hosted by an NVIDIA reseller. NVIDIA's own resources.nvidia.com copy renders as a JS PDF viewer. Every Tensor Core figure is 'sparse, and dense is one-half of the sparse spec shown'. AUDIT FLAG: Spec-sheet content is NVIDIA's, but the PDF is hosted on reseller domain nor-tech.com, not on an NVIDIA domain. Publisher is recorded as NVIDIA because the document itself is NVIDIA-authored, but this is not a first-party-hosted URL - verify against resources.nvidia.com before treating as primary.
